name: Portfolio Benchmark
definition: Security or other price against which the performance of the portfolio is evaluated.

BenchmarkWeight.name: Benchmark Weight
BenchmarkWeight.definition: Instrument weighting in the benchmark for the portfolio.

MaximumDeviation.name: Maximum Deviation
MaximumDeviation.definition: Maximum allowable deviation from the benchmark.

MinimumDeviation.name: Minimum Deviation
MinimumDeviation.definition: Minimum allowable deviation from the benchmark.

EffectivePeriod.name: Effective Period
EffectivePeriod.definition: Period during which the instrument is used as a benchmark for the portfolio.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Free text description of the benchmark used to determine the performance of a portfolio.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Specifies the index which may be used for decomposition.

Portfolio.name: Portfolio
Portfolio.definition: Portfolio to which the benchmark applies.

Approver.name: Approver
Approver.definition: Party who is the supervised entity endorsing the benchmark.

Administrator.name: Administrator
Administrator.definition: Party who is administrating the benchmark.
